findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "?source=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_hvac_filter_info, search_carsafe · Private data: get_hvac_filter_info, search_carsafe, prepare_carsafe_purchase, submit_b2b_inquiry · Public sink: submit_b2b_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_hvac_filter_info, search_carsafe · Private data: get_hvac_filter_info, search_carsafe, prepare_carsafe_purchase, submit_b2b_inquiry · Public sink: submit_b2b_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_hvac_filter_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
